caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical device that is predominantly rectangular in shape and appears to be constructed from wood, as indicated by its brown color and visible wood grain texture. The front and sides of the box are decorated with symmetrical, light tan-colored ornate patterns. On the front left side, there is a dark, curved metal crank handle with a rounded knob for turning. At the top center of the device, there is a large horizontal metal cylinder with evenly spaced holes, around which a beige paper roll is wrapped. On top of the cylinder, there are eight evenly spaced vertical metal levers or hammers. To the right of the cylinder, there is a metal crank with a circular handle. The overall background of the drawing is plain and light tan in color, with no additional objects or patterns present.
title: Melodeon
